title: Last digit as a char
prompt: Implement `char lastDigitChar(int n)`: the last digit of non-negative `n`, returned as a `char` (`'7'`, not `7`). `%` gives the digit; adding `'0'` converts a digit to its character.

tests.name: digit characters
tests.hint: n % 10 is the digit; digit + '0' is its char value.
